verse.verse_1: A questioner asked concerning a torment about to befall
verse.verse_2: Upon the disbelievers, which none can avert,
verse.verse_3: From Allah, the Lord of the ways of ascent.
verse.verse_4: The angels and the Ruh ascend to Him in a Day the measure whereof is fifty thousand years.
verse.verse_5: So be patient, with a good patience.
verse.verse_6: Verily, they see it (the torment) afar off.
verse.verse_8: The Day that the sky will be like the Al-Muhl.
verse.verse_9: And the mountains will be like `Ihn.
verse.verse_10: And no friend will ask a friend,
verse.verse_11: Though they shall be made to see one another, the criminal would desire to ransom himself from the punishment of that Day by his children.
verse.verse_12: And his wife and his brother,
verse.verse_13: And his Fasilah who sheltered him,
verse.verse_14: And all that are in the earth, so that it might save him.
verse.verse_15: By no means! Verily, it will be the fire of Hell,
verse.verse_17: Calling (all) such as turn their backs and turn away their faces.
verse.verse_18: And collect (wealth) and hide it (from spending it in the cause of Allah).
verse.verse_19: Verily, man was created very impatient;
verse.verse_21: And suppressive when good touches him.
verse.verse_22: Except those who are devoted to Salah.
verse.verse_23: Those who with their Salah are Da'imun;
verse.verse_24: And those in whose wealth there is a recognized right.
verse.verse_25: For the one who asks, and for the deprived.
verse.verse_26: And those who believe in the Day of Recompense.
verse.verse_27: And those who fear the torment of their Lord.
verse.verse_28: Verily, the torment of their Lord is that before which none can feel secure.
verse.verse_29: And those who guard their private part (chastity).
verse.verse_30: Except from their wives or their right hand possessions -- for (then) they are not blameworthy.
verse.verse_31: But whosoever seeks beyond that, then it is those who are trespassers.
verse.verse_32: And those who keep their trusts and covenants.
verse.verse_33: And those who stand firm in their testimonies.
verse.verse_34: And those who are with their Salah, Yuhafizun.
verse.verse_35: Such shall dwell in the Gardens, honored
verse.verse_36: So, what is the matter with those disbelievers, before you Muhti`in
verse.verse_37: On the right and on the left, `Izin.
verse.verse_38: Does every man of them hope to enter the Paradise of Delight
verse.verse_39: But no! Verily, We have created them out of that which they know!
verse.verse_40: But no! I swear by the Lord of the easts and the wests that surely We are Able
verse.verse_41: To replace them by (others) better than them; and We are not to be outrun.
verse.verse_42: So, leave them to plunge in vain talk and play about, until they meet their Day which they are promised.
verse.verse_43: The Day when they will come out of the graves quickly as racing to a Nusub,
verse.verse_44: With their eyes lowered in fear and humility, ignominy covering them (all over)! That is the Day which they were promised!
